[type]
Lexer

[grammar]
lexer grammar L;
UID   : [a-zA-Z]+ { <IsUID()> }? { <PlusText("UID "):writeln()> } ;
LID   : [a-zA-Z]+ { <IsLID()> }? { <PlusText("LID "):writeln()> } ;
WS   : [ \n] -> skip ;

[input]
enum ENUM

[output]
LID enum
UID ENUM
[@0,0:3='enum',<2>,1:0]
[@1,5:8='ENUM',<1>,1:5]
[@2,9:8='<EOF>',<-1>,1:9]
